title: The context-index builder lists the code index as an on-demand L3 knowledge entry with its freshness.
source: console, 2026-10-26. In the 7 days to 2026-10-26, evolve code usage counted 2 calls, both from the console, and no call from a phase agent. Design: docs/architecture/code-index-cli.md section 4 (F4.4, D5.4, D5.5).
summary: The consumer is the L3 knowledge layer of the context-index builder (CX7b, item context-index-knowledge-layer, PR #1139). The builder must give each phase cell the evolve code verbs as one on-demand L3 entry. The entry carries the stale and behind fields that evolve code --json now reports, so a phase agent sees when the index is behind origin/main.
fix: In the L3 entry of kind code-index, name the verbs callers, api, find and map with --json. Copy stale and behind from one evolve code map --json read at cell build. When stale is true, name evolve code refresh as a request (agent class R), never as a command that the cell runs.
acceptance: RED first: TestBuild_TheCodeIndexEntryCarriesTheFreshnessOfTheIndex fails before the change.
The entry is L3, class knowledge, never required, and adds no grant.
An absent index gives no entry and no error.
Changed functions at 100% coverage on every CI OS; the package note and the spec are updated.
